Based on the erotic game by Dwarfsoft.

His passions were inflamed by the residents' beautiful faces and excellent bodies, but he feared they may call the police if he tried anything. Sneaking into a healthy, virile man's bedroom at night? At her age, there's no way she didn't know what she was doing... And indeed, it progressed to sex. He didn't believe her, but he was under her spell... he'd do it, and with her full consent. The next day, Ichirou's job as a tutor began. But when he lifted her skirt, he found a tightly-locked chastity belt. Nakoto smirked "If you want to have sex with me, get mom pregnant..."
